shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "dropdown|menu" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu

sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -C3 "Button|Icon|view" | head -80; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -3; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version"; grep -n gravity package-lock.json | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/; cat build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; rg -n "DropdownMenu" README.md | head
